title: Soil and Litter GitHub Issues Tracker
text:
I updated the validation workflow by refactoring dataset screening (#514), switching to a per-dataset schema (#519), refining database building (#522), and triaging soil-litter issues (#531). I also completed Stage 2 of adding validation datasets (#525) and screened more soil and litter datasets (#526). Codebase and tooling updates included adapting subset_nc() to handle Zarr outputs (#510, #509), parsing the VE codebase to build a constants database for calibration (#508), documenting sourced functions in R templates (#292), and explicitly referencing external R function dependencies (#297). I closed the enzyme concentration modeling issue because it will not be addressed in the near term (#63).





Combining the newly added soil gas flux validation dataset with VE outputs is currently blocked, awaiting VE updates (#62). I also need to recompile soil input data (#538).



I need to update the LLM prompt to group soil microbial and enzyme constants (#534), implement RAG for VE docs after reverting changes in #506 (#532), and add a raw dataset filtering option to build_validation_database (#523).
